question: What interval is prescribed for the rear cord at the hollow of the spine?
premises: The reference is the rear cord at the hollow of the spine.
The interval is measured in parts.
The amount is two parts less by a quarter.
inference: The rear cord at the hollow of the spine is at an interval of two parts less a quarter.
